'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kingery LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Play it Again, Sam''' (sheet may read Saul). Username '''Archmage'''. Line 26 '''Kin Koin/Kin Kour''' → Kinyen; line 20 Home One Mon Calamari Star Cruiser (V) after correction.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers]]
* '''Username:''' Archmage
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
